message.content: On April 10th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz and LiHua had a discussion about the next song they would work on during their jam session. Initially, WolfgangSchulz suggested using an app to help him improve his drumming skills, and LiHua was open to trying it out during their next jam session. However, they also discussed their musical repertoire, with WolfgangSchulz suggesting playing something upbeat and considering classic Beatles tracks or mixing in some classic rock. LiHua proposed a classic song with a nice groove, leading to the suggestion of "Stand By Me." WolfgangSchulz agreed that a mix of new arrangements and the original version could make the performance more fun. YurikoYamamoto enthusiastically supported this idea, and they were all excited about the upcoming jam session. Thus, the new song they decided to work on was "Stand By Me."
